description: Cross-language test vectors for MetaMUI Argon2 implementations
note: Test vectors sourced from RFC 9106 Section 4, the PHC reference implementation, and the RustCrypto argon2 v0.5 reference

test_vectors.name: RFC 9106 Argon2d
test_vectors.description: RFC 9106 §4.1 canonical Argon2d tag. Cross-checked against PHC libargon2 20190702 (Phase O3).

test_vectors.name: RFC 9106 Argon2i
test_vectors.description: RFC 9106 Section 4 Argon2i test vector with secret and associated data

test_vectors.name: RFC 9106 Argon2id
test_vectors.description: RFC 9106 Section 4 Argon2id test vector with secret and associated data

test_vectors.name: PHC Reference Argon2i (64MiB)
test_vectors.description: Argon2i with 64 MiB memory, 2 iterations from PHC reference

test_vectors.name: PHC Reference Argon2d (64MiB)
test_vectors.description: Argon2d with 64 MiB memory, 2 iterations from RustCrypto reference

test_vectors.name: PHC Reference Argon2id (64MiB)
test_vectors.description: Argon2id with 64 MiB memory, 2 iterations from PHC reference

test_vectors.name: Minimal Argon2i
test_vectors.description: Argon2i with minimum memory (64 KiB), single iteration

test_vectors.name: Minimal Argon2d
test_vectors.description: Argon2d with minimum memory (64 KiB), single iteration

test_vectors.name: Minimal Argon2id
test_vectors.description: Argon2id with minimum memory (64 KiB), single iteration

test_vectors.name: Argon2i with Parallelism
test_vectors.description: Argon2i with 256 KiB memory, 2 iterations, parallelism=4

test_vectors.name: Argon2id Cross-Language Test 1
test_vectors.description: Argon2id cross-language compatibility vector 1 (regenerated from PHC reference argon2 CLI 20190702, Phase O2)

test_vectors.name: Argon2id Cross-Language Test 2 - Unicode
test_vectors.description: Argon2id cross-language compatibility vector with Unicode password (regenerated from PHC reference argon2 CLI 20190702, Phase O2)

implementation_notes.general: All vectors use Argon2 version 0x13 (v1.3). The RFC 9106 vectors include secret and associated data fields; implementations that do not support these parameters should skip those three vectors.
implementation_notes.rust: Reference implementation - all non-RFC vectors generated from metamui-argon2 (based on RustCrypto argon2 v0.5)

verification_steps: 1. Run each test vector through the Rust (reference) implementation to confirm hashes
2. Test all other implementations against these expected_hash values
3. Ensure all implementations produce identical results for same inputs
4. For RFC 9106 vectors (first 3), implementations must support secret and associated data
5. Verify password verification works across implementations

compatibility_requirements.hash_output: All implementations must produce identical hash outputs for same inputs
compatibility_requirements.verification: Any implementation should verify passwords hashed by any other implementation
compatibility_requirements.deterministic: Same inputs must always produce same outputs
compatibility_requirements.variants: All three variants (Argon2d, Argon2i, Argon2id) must be supported
